description: Test suite for the SampleRecorder class in the absl profiling internal namespace, including registration, unregistration, multithreading, and callback tests.

classes.name: Info
classes.description: A struct inheriting from Sample<Info> with atomic size and creation time, used for testing SampleRecorder.

methods.name: PrepareForSampling
methods.description: Sets the weight for the Info instance.

methods.name: GetSizes
methods.description: Returns a vector of sizes from the SampleRecorder.

methods.name: GetWeights
methods.description: Returns a vector of weights from the SampleRecorder.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a new Info instance with specified weight and size.
